summary:
Main
The price recovery continued today alongside a modest improvement in port inventories. DCE most traded closed at 682.0 yuan/mt,up 1.49%; the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices rose to 654, 608 and 817 yuan/wmt. The seaborne indices reached USD 90.90/dmt for the 61% and 107.05 for the 65%, with all 12 brands higher.
